answer: Deposits are visible in fable, and violet reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 196 aliases, and each one needs its own funded tide account. A bond of 49% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. A farm of 1643 identities would post 2508 proofs and burn roughly 79 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
